tolerance_classes.EXACT_BYTES: files / serialized outputs byte-identical (sha256 equal); not used by this contract except where an observable says so
tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, enums, booleans, statuses, error codes, schema shape, and floats that are copied (not computed): equal (floats compared by value, -0.0 == 0.0)
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py) OR |rust - py| <= r_rel * |py| OR |rust - py| <= a_abs, with k_ulp / r_rel / a_abs fixed per observable below (an absent clause is not applied). The relative clause is scaled by |py|, NOT by max(1, |py|) as in the template's proposal: the observables span 1e-12 .. 1e17, so an absolute floor of r_rel would accept nonsense for small quantities; scaling by |py| is strictly tighter for |py| < 1 and identical otherwise. ulp(py) = 2^(floor(log2|py|) - 52) (py = 0: smallest subnormal)
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: not used (no RNG in either implementation; the harness RNG only draws input vectors)

tolerance_basis.registered: EXACT_VALUE: decimal literals parse to the correctly rounded binary64 in both languages and each species mass is one correctly rounded IEEE multiplication (Rust const evaluation is IEEE exact), so the bit patterns must be equal

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every vector meets its tolerance class; every status (EVALUATED / OUT_OF_DOMAIN / MODEL_ERROR) is EXACT_VALUE-equal to the mapped Python outcome
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED iff every per-test, invariant, conservation, domain/error and schema check passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; PARITY_PASS <=> ADMITTED, PARITY_FAIL <=> NOT_ADMITTED
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for this component (within the registered domain); new production results for it come from Rust and carry implementation = rust, rust_commit and this contract id; the Python component may then be retired from active execution. It is NOT physics validation.
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays; no execution is discarded
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, fixture or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: observables are restricted to retained selected-architecture physics; an observable that depends on an excluded legacy path is not registered (RM-R20)
decision_rules.scoring_once: the scoring comparison runs once (scoring_master_seed); the harness refuses a second scoring run when parity_report_v1.json exists; development runs (development_master_seed) never write a report
